name: Instant Jump
description: Input assist for jumping: input buffering, input queuing, double-click fix, slope assist, jump prediction, and smoother ship / wave spam. Builds on the game's own timestamped clicks.

enabled.name: Enable Instant Jump
enabled.description: Master switch. When off, the game handles clicks exactly like vanilla (it already applies each click at its exact sub-step in 2.2081).

step-guard.name: Queue Inputs Per Step
step-guard.description: Input queuing: the first click of a physics step is applied instantly, and any extra presses/releases in the same step are queued so each one lasts at least one full step. This is what makes fast ship / UFO tapping and <cy>Wave</c> spam register every click, and keeps straight flying consistent.

double-click-fix.name: Double-Click Fix
double-click-fix.description: Ignores a second press that arrives faster than a human can click (mouse / controller bounce).

double-click-ms.name: Double-Click Window (ms)
double-click-ms.description: Presses closer together than this are treated as one click. Lower it if you spam extremely fast.

buffering.name: Input Buffering
buffering.description: A click made shortly BEFORE you land is remembered and fires the moment you touch the ground.

buffer-ms.name: Buffer Window (ms)
buffer-ms.description: How long a mid-air click is remembered. Higher = more forgiving, but a mid-air orb click may also cause an extra jump on landing. Use 0 to disable buffering.

queue-size.name: Buffered Clicks Kept
queue-size.description: How many mid-air clicks can wait in the buffer at once (input queue length).

slope-assist.name: Slope Assist
slope-assist.description: Landing on or sliding off a slope flickers the 'on ground' flag. This widens the buffer window while you are on, or just left, a slope.

slope-extra-ms.name: Slope Extra Window (ms)
slope-extra-ms.description: Extra buffer time added on slopes.

prediction.name: Jump Prediction
prediction.description: While you are falling, the buffer window grows with your fall speed (fast falls cover more distance per millisecond, so landing timing is tighter).

prediction-ms.name: Max Prediction Bonus (ms)
prediction-ms.description: Largest extra buffer time Jump Prediction can add at full fall speed.
